source_articles.content: VALORANT Patch Notes 13.05 Pick’Ems for Champs soon, penalties for stream sniping and instalock tools, and future changes to the Agent Gear system. Game Updates Ashley Tsao 2026-09-01T13:00:00.000Z TLDR; Pick’ Ems for Champs, penalties for stream sniping and instalock tools, and future changes to the Agent Gear system so make sure to grind it out and get all the items now! Heyo, it’s Ash and we’ve got a small-ish patch for you with mostly bug fixes. We’re prepping for a pretty beefy next patch in 13.06 so more to come! Let’s get it. ALL PLATFORMS COSMETICS UPDATES Sound Sprays Based on your feedback, we've adjusted the sound attenuation for all sound sprays so you'll only be able to hear the sounds if you're nearby to ensure teams can communicate effectively. This will be a standard for all future audio sprays. ESPORTS FEATURES Pick’Ems have returned for Champions Shanghai ! Starting on September 10, you will have access to the Group Stage in-client and on the web. Predict the advancing teams for points, earning extra points for correctly guessing the exact placement. You’ll also earn rewards just for participating. Get your picks in before Groups kickoff on September 24th! PLAYER BEHAVIOR UPDATES We've started rolling out penalties if we detect usage of stream sniping and instalock tools. Players found using these tools will be subject to temporary game bans that will escalate to permanent with repeated usage. PROGRESSION UPDATES Agent Gear Heads up, gamers! With the release of Patch 13.06 on September 22, we'll be revamping the Agent Gear system and the way you unlock items on that progression track. You will still keep the gear you've already earned, and you'll continue to use Kingdom Credits to unlock future gear. But after Patch 13.06, each piece of gear will be tied directly to how much you play the associated Agent. So if you're currently grinding for Agent Gear on any Agents you don't usually play, now's your chance to lock in and get those unlocks. BUG FIXE

The City and MyTEAM Rewards : Players earn XP across The City and MyTEAM with cross-progression, climbing the 40-level rewards ladder to earn MyPLAYER cosmetics, Badge Tokens, Badge Slots, Cap Breakers, and MyTEAM cards from Amethyst to Dark Matter. More Ways to Earn : The Season 1 Pro Pass and Hall of Fame Pass offer 40 additional levels of rewards, while the NBA 2K HQ companion app helps players keep up with NBA 2K27 in-game events and pack drops. Today, 2K unveiled the first Season of NBA® 2K27 , the latest iteration of the NBA video game franchise developed by Visual Concepts and published by 2K, arriving on Wednesday, August 26. Season 1 features Victor Wembanyama - San Antonio Spurs superstar, the 2025-2026 unanimous Defensive Player of the Year, and NBA 2K27 ’s Standard Edition cover athlete - as the headliner. Every game played in Season 1 earns XP toward a new wave of content across The City and MyTEAM. NBA 2K27 Season 1 Rewards and Updates The City : With every game played in Season 1, players earn XP and climb the rewards ladder toward unlocks like Skill Boosts, MyPLAYER cosmetics, Cap Breakers, and all-new Badge Tokens. Featured rewards include the Level 16 Orange Swirl Hoverboard, Level 29 Cyber Robot Eyes, Level 36 ‘Prowl’ - Minnesota Lynx Mascot, Level 39 Ninja Suit: Apprentice, and more. Season 1 Events in The City : 2XREP Weekends and other limited-time events are back in Season 1. Players can compete and finish games in Casual Corner, The REC, The Theater, Ante-Up, Proving Grounds, and Crew Divisions in Crew HQ to receive 2XREP rewards. Additional events this Season

Welcome to Hell Discover the critically acclaimed franchise that defined the Action RPG genre. As the battle between the High Heavens and Burning Hells rages on, so too does your chance to fight for good to prevail. Hatred devours Sanctuary as evil spreads and a new wave of cultists and worshippers arise to embrace Lilith’s coming. Only a brave few dare to face this threat and bring light to the all-consuming darkness. Latest Updates What’s New in Sanctuary LORD OF HATRED™ New Expansion Confront Mephisto, the Prime Evil and Lord of Hatred, in the all-new expansion Lord of Hatred. Battle across the ancient islands of Skovos, uncover two new playable classes, and face the final reckoning in Diablo IV’s most ambitious chapter yet. Discover new dungeons, and endgame activities that will make you risk it all for Sanctuary. View Expansion New Season: Season of Death Awakening New Season Tear open Ruptures, conquer completely redesigned Realmwalkers, and confront a corrupted Reaper for your best chance at earning Mythic Unique rewards.
